Outer ornament limited to 24px of runtime edge; center entirely alpha. Preserve title y136-172 and effect y180-300 safe areas with no overlap. 3. Project visual anchor: res://assets/ui/generated/battle_ui_v5/primary_action_normal.png and tactical_bezel.png establish midnight blue-grey glass #172331, restrained aged copper #b98b55, fine worn hand-painted edges; mother portrait res://assets/core/ART_CORE_MotherFlower_Healthy.png establishes upper-left soft warm light. 4. Composition and states: front-view rounded rectangle botanical metal edging with sparse copper leaves at four corners, no perspective. Top and bottom continuous quiet edges, no holes through silhouette; empty transparent center. Native hover/pressed border handled separately, one shared normal master. 5. Comfort: low saturation, no glow, no blinking or motion streaks, light sparse texture, legible edge at small display. 6. Exclusions: no text, no watermark, no logo, no unintended objects, no baked UI, no plant portrait, no paper center, no neon, no brand imitation, no glossy sci-fi metal. 7. Transparency: true transparent RGBA alpha everywhere outside frame and inside center; clean antialiased alpha edges, no white/black/matte/color backdrop, no checkerboard, no environmental background.
